import { defineCommand } from '@unbrained/pm-cli/sdk/authoring';
export const command = defineCommand({ name: 'example count', description: 'Typed public SDK usage', run(ctx) { const root: string = ctx.pm_root; return { root }; } });

import { PmClient, certifyCompleteListResult } from '@unbrained/pm-cli/sdk';
export async function count(pmRoot: string): Promise<number> { const result = await new PmClient({ pmRoot, noExtensions: true }).listAllComplete(); certifyCompleteListResult(result); return result.items.length; }
